summary: The filing is an 8-K from National Presto Industries reporting that its defense subsidiaries, AMTEC Corporation and Spectra Technologies, LLC, received a 40mm contract option and a Small Diameter Bomb warhead subcontract totaling $159.1 million on August 13, 2026. This is an ordinary business update on government contract awards, not a special situation event. The registrant is the filer disclosing material contract news. The filing includes a press release and forward-looking statements. No transaction, strategic change, or capital event is involved. What to watch: none; routine defense contract disclosure.
